classes.definition: No model candidate was actually produced/executed for the scored event.
Runner/provider/account/network/storage prevented execution before the scientific scoring event.
Scorer/verifier equivalence relation is semantically inapplicable to the authoritative task/evaluator contract.
Intended valid verifier/parser/harness failed due implementation/data binding/runtime defect.
Observed output is intermediate/partial and terminal evidence chain required by the task is not complete.
Authoritative output grammar/format was valid and known, instrument was valid, but the model output itself failed that required contract.
Model candidate was scored by a valid applicable instrument and is semantically incorrect.
Tool/capability was available and valid, but the model/controller supplied invalid selection/arguments or otherwise caused the tool-use failure.
Selected external capability/tool failed independently of candidate reasoning/arguments after valid invocation.
Requested action could not legally/operationally execute because authority or policy denied it.
Candidate passed the applicable authoritative contract.
Available evidence is insufficient to attribute the event safely.

hard_invariants: No MODEL_TASK_FAILURE may be emitted when instrument_applicable=false.
No model-quality denominator entry when candidate_executed=false.
Infrastructure and billing blocks never count as model failures.
Applicable-instrument implementation failure never counts as model failure.
Unknown attribution is HOLD, not FAIL.
A valid pass requires candidate execution plus applicable functioning instrument.
If task/output grammar itself requires a format, candidate format violation may be a model output-contract failure; parser implementation defects are not.

priority_rules: If no candidate exists because execution never started -> NO_MODEL_EVIDENCE or INFRASTRUCTURE_BLOCKED.
If authoritative evaluator contract is mismatched by the candidate instrument -> INSTRUMENT_CONTRACT_MISMATCH before any model verdict.
If intended evaluator is applicable but its implementation/data binding/runtime fails -> INSTRUMENT_IMPLEMENTATION_FAILURE.
If authority/policy forbids the requested effect -> AUTHORITY_POLICY_DENIED.
If external evidence chain is nonterminal/partial -> EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE.
If a valid required output grammar is violated by candidate output -> MODEL_OUTPUT_CONTRACT_FAILURE.
If valid tool invocation fails independently of model/controller input -> CAPABILITY_EXECUTION_FAILURE.
If tool failure is caused by model/controller selection or arguments -> MODEL_TOOL_USE_FAILURE.
If applicable instrument scores candidate semantically wrong -> MODEL_TASK_FAILURE.
If applicable instrument scores candidate correct -> VALID_PASS.
